mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task(project_id, title, description, priority, status, deadline, creator_id, assignee_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{deadline}, #{creatorId}, #{assigneeId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, title, description, priority, status, deadline, creator_id, assignee_id, create_time, update_time FROM task WHERE id = #{id}
